Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHERE a campaign is active for the store of a purchase, the loyalty service shall multiply the points earned by the campaign multiplier.
The loyalty service shall record the member, the store and the time of each points transaction.
WHEN the customer mobile app requests a balance, the loyalty service shall return the customer's points balance.
Rationale: Members check their balance after paying.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service issues a voucher, the loyalty service shall set the voucher value to SGD 1 per 100 redeemed points.
